sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: The gameplay in Falling Rock is straightforward yet engaging. Your goal is to avoid falling rocks by jumping at the right time. The rocks fall from the top of the screen, and you can move left or right to position yourself for the perfect jump. The game becomes increasingly challenging as the speed and size of the rocks increase. You can earn points for each rock you avoid, and your score will be displayed prominently on the screen. The game also features a smooth and responsive controls system, allowing you to jump and move with precision and speed. As you progress through the game, you'll encounter various obstacles, such as large rocks or rocks that change direction mid-air, which will require quick reflexes and sharp instincts to overcome.
